title: Panels
description: Button panels for your server. The bot posts them; if there was already one in the same channel, it replaces it.

verify.title: Verification
verify.text: New members accept the rules with one button and receive the member role.
verify.blocker: The member role they get after accepting isn’t set.
verify.hint: The rules channel isn’t set (the panel would refer to it).

suggestion.title: Suggestions
suggestion.text: Members can send suggestions via a form; the bot posts them to the suggestion channel with voting.
suggestion.blocker: It isn’t set where suggestions should go.

bug.title: Bug reports
bug.text: Bug reports via a form; the staff reviews them in the bug channel.
bug.blocker: It isn’t set where reports should go.

honeypot.title: Spam trap
honeypot.text: A warning card in the trap channel. Anyone who writes there is punished automatically by the bot (against spam bots).
honeypot.blocker: The trap channel isn’t set — create one with one click, or pick an existing one.
honeypot.creating: The bot is creating the trap channel…

ownPages: Panels managed on their own page

duty.title: Duty
duty.text: Clock in and out with one button, live list of who's on duty, own time, leave requests (Components V2). You can post several panels; all update live.
duty.blocker: The Duty module is turned off.
duty.hint: No log channel — clock ins and outs aren't logged.
